name: GP Big Island Mill - Big Island VA

fieldNotes.facility: Integrated containerboard pulp/paper mill on the west bank of the James River, Big Island VA — Virginia's oldest continuously operating business (125+ years). Confirmed via address (10097/9909 Lee Jackson Hwy), GP locations page, and satellite (mill building, woodyard with chip piles, clarifiers, wastewater treatment ponds, chemical storage tanks).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Mill is a fully fenced, self-contained complex; access road crosses the Norfolk Southern rail line off Lee Jackson Hwy. A controlled gated entrance is standard for a mill of this scale and age; not directly resolvable in Street View due to roadside tree cover and the rail buffer — medium confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred from facility scale and security profile; a staffed booth could not be positively imaged. Listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large trailer drop yard runs along the riverbank south of the mill core — 60-80 trailers visible parked in angled rows; banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Loading docks along the east face of the mill and at warehouse/converting buildings; trailers visible backed in. Count ~14 estimated from overhead imagery, low confidence.
fieldNotes.scale: A truck scale is typical at a mill receiving wood fiber by truck; not positively imaged — listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spur clearly curves into the property alongside the main mill building.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Unincorporated village of Big Island, rural setting 12 mi NW of Lynchburg, surrounded by forest and farmland.
